t: A zero-code AI vision sensor that detects faces and learns targets with one button.
steps: Find the Boson AI Vision Sense i37 on the DFRobot wiki.
Ask DFRobot for the price and where to buy it.
Get a BOSON controller or output module.
Plug the sensor in with the PH2.0 cable.
Choose a mode with the onboard button.
Press Learn to teach a target.
Test the sensor with the output module.
